newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to decide on sugar tender on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to decide on sugar tender on Sunday.

text.p: The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan (TCP) said on Saturday it had opened bids for the import of 50,000 tonnes of crystal white refined sugar but will announce the decision on Sunday.
"We have opened the bids and have presented them before the evaluation committee," a TCP official who asked not to be named said. "The committee will announce its decision on Sunday."
TCP had invited tenders on May 12 from international suppliers for the import of 50,000 tonnes of crystal white refined sugar to be delivered in two equal shipments by June 30 and July 15, 1997.

The official said sugar imports have been planned for June and July period to control rising domestic prices and an expected shortage during July-September period when the sugar crushing season reaches its end. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
